The title of this class is: "Analyzing Windows malware traffic with Wireshark (Part 1)" and was taught by Brad Duncan. This was recorded on June 12th at UC Berkeley. 

https://sharkfestus.wireshark.org


Subscribe to our channel for tons of free Wireshark educational content. To attend a live SharkFest and to learn Wireshark with packet analysis experts, visit: https://sharkfest.wireshark.org.
